visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border. Use 'border border-white/10' globally for cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use inner glows for active states rather than drop shadows: 'shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]'
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. Use 'rounded-md' (6px) or 'rounded-lg' (8px) everywhere to maintain a structural, terminal feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid heavy blur. Use 'bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md' exclusively for sticky bottom nav or header. Do not use fully transparent headers.

grids.bento: Use dense grid layouts. 'grid-cols-2 gap-4' for mobile dashboards. Span full width for charts ('col-span-2').
grids.spacing: Use 'p-4' for standard cards, 'p-6' for hero elements. Maintain tight density for trading stats to fit more data on screen.

layouts.navigation: Sticky Bottom Navigation Bar ('fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 pb-safe'). Top Header with Server Status.
layouts.containers: Max width 'max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative pb-24' to simulate mobile app on desktop browsers while keeping it full width on actual mobile devices.

components.buttons: Sharp, technical. 'bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-md transition-colors'. Primary action (Claim/Auth) uses brand gold: 'bg-[#FFB800] hover:bg-[#E6A600] text-black font-bold'.
components.cards: 'bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 rounded-md overflow-hidden relative'. Must have explicit hover state if interactive (e.g. Market list items).
components.inputs: Technical auth input. 'bg-black border border-white/20 rounded-md font-mono text-center focus:border-[#FFB800] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FFB800]'.
components.tabs: Segmented control style. 'bg-white/5 p-1 rounded-md'. Active tab 'bg-[#1C1C1E] shadow-sm text-white'.
components.charts: Recharts. Remove grid lines, hide axes, use simple stroke lines with linearGradient fills. Positive/Negative color mapping based on delta. Ring chart for portfolio breakdown.

motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion. Fade and slight slide up: 'initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}'.
motion.celebration: Daily check-in requires a celebratory burst using Framer Motion (staggered particles) or a confetti/reward animation sequence.

economy_hero.description: Abstract neon lines forming a digital landscape. Use with a low opacity overlay as a background texture for the Portfolio or Economy Pulse headers.

vote_site_bg.description: Gold coins in darkness. Use for Vote Site cards or the Daily check-in claim card backdrop.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first PWA using React (JavaScript), Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
DO NOT CREATE .tsx FILES. ONLY .js AND .jsx ARE ALLOWED.
Implement navigation optimized for a bottom tab bar layout (Dashboard, Market, Portfolio, Vote).
Use Recharts for the stock market sparklines and the main Portfolio pie/ring chart. Make charts highly readable in dark mode.
Format all prices with 'G' (Gold) suffix and use 'JetBrains Mono' font for all numeric data.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are present on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) to support automated testing.
For the player auth /link logic, use a 6-character code input stylized heavily with monospace font to look like a Minecraft server code / 2FA.
Implement the Daily Check-In with a 7-day streak grid. Active 'Claim' button should have a visual pulse.
Vote Cards must have a 24h countdown timer state and external link logic pointing to rootmc.net.
All components should be optimized for touch (min 44px tap targets).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Opt for left-aligned or grid-based optical alignment.
DO NOT use dark colors as full UI gradients (e.g., from-gray-900 to-black). Keep background surfaces solid flat colors like #050505.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers/navs only. Never use a fully transparent header.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states, click compressions.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md with explicit hover states).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use lucide-react for all iconography.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., upon successful daily claim or voting).
